_comment: MODELLED steady-state projection, not measured data. Describes the house once the heat pump is installed (December 2026), the switch to Intelligent Octopus Go is done, and export is actually being paid. IOG went live 2026-09-15 and paid export 2026-09-22; the heat pump is still to come. The measured, real-money figures are in data/daily/*.json and on /stats/. Replace with measured figures after a full year in the finished configuration.
assumes: heat pump installed and gas supply removed
on Intelligent Octopus Go at 8p overnight
gas priced at the 7.39p market average, not our expiring 6.24p fix

baseline_gbp._note: same house, no solar, no battery, gas boiler, petrol Qashqai and diesel C4, on our current fixed tariff

marginal_gbp.note: what we'd lose if the panels and battery came off but the car and heat pump stayed
against the petrol Qashqai and diesel C4 it replaced, at September 2026 pump prices
against the 19-year-old gas boiler, at the 7.39p market gas price

overlap_note: The three figures add up to £5,528, but the real total is £4,662. Each change is worth more when the others are in place, because every new load gives the battery and the cheap overnight window more to do. Each figure is fine on its own, but they can't be added together.
